verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows that Typesense is built for instant, sub-50ms search-as-you-type experiences, and one community user praises its instant search queries. That covers results-as-you-type autocomplete over indexed documents, but nothing in the pack shows query suggestions drawn from real search traffic or a dedicated suggestions index. Missing for 10: query-suggestion or popular-query features, analytics capture of real search traffic, a documented suggestions-index workflow, and independent hands-on corroboration of autocomplete suggestions.
